Obtuse angles are greater than 90 degrees.

questions.question_text:
An angle measures exactly $180^{\circ}$.
How is it classified?

options.why: Obtuse angles are below 180 degrees, not equal to it.
Reflex angles are greater than 180 degrees.
A revolution is a full 360-degree turn.

questions.question_text: How is an angle of $305^{\circ}$ classified?

options.why: Obtuse angles lie between 90 and 180 degrees only.
A straight angle is exactly 180 degrees.
A revolution is exactly 360 degrees, not 305 degrees.

questions.question_text: How is an angle of exactly $360^{\circ}$ classified?

options.why: Reflex angles are less than 360 degrees, not equal to it.
A straight angle is half a revolution at 180 degrees.
A right angle is one quarter of a revolution at 90 degrees.
